race.comment: CLAIRE BEAR (2) broke through for her maiden success last time out at this track over 380m (21.61). Winner at her latest appearance in the quickest time on the card. Looks the testing material. MISS TARGET (1) continues to race well but is struggling to break through, placing at her last four runs. Last start finished 2nd in a Maiden on October 16 over 380m at this track behind SISTER HOLLY beaten 1.5 lengths (22.06). Overdue and expected to feature again. RADCLIFF (7) can measure up this time. DASH STRATUS (8) has been in the money at her last two runs, most recently when third (22.34) in a Maiden over 380m at this track.
